{{Quote|Well, all right, then. Come back soon. We appreciate your patronage.|Bartender of Rojio's|<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>}}
'''Rojio's''' was a bar in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Hullis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]].<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]] conducted a [[Halmad campaign|mission]] to steal [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] from [[Victory Base]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base on the planet. It began with the Wraiths [[Kell Tainer]] and [[Ton Phanan]] starting a fight with a group of Imperial [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] drinking at Rojio's. The [[Unidentified bartender (Rojio's)|bartender]] pleaded for them to stop but was ignored; he then contacted the local military police via his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />

When the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] arrived, they arrested everyone involved in the fight. To the bartender's relief, Phanan offered to pay for the damages&mdash;nearing the total of a hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]&mdash;incurred during the fight.<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />
